textbookBox.concept: To rescue means to save someone from danger. The book asks who rescues us in trouble, such as firefighters, doctors and the police. The policeman in the story is the village kotwal.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: To rescue means to save someone from danger. The book asks who rescues us in trouble, such as firefighters, doctors and the police. The policeman in the story is the village kotwal. Some people say thaanedar.
beats.speakEn: To rescue means to save someone from danger. The book asks who rescues us in trouble, such as firefighters, doctors and the police. The policeman in the story is the village kotwal. Some people say thaanedar.

beats.en: The story is set in a village at night. The main characters are the husband and wife, and the kotwal named Rama. Other characters are the thief who enters the house.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 6 english · Rama to the Rescue · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: At the end of a hard day the man and his wife are very sleepy, and they lie down to rest. Then the wife hears a noise and asks the husband to be quiet and listen.

beats.en: At the end of a hard day the man and his wife are very sleepy, and they lie down to rest. Then the wife hears a noise and asks the husband to be quiet and listen. He realises somebody is trying to get in.
beats.speakEn: At the end of a hard day the man and his wife are very sleepy, and they lie down to rest. Then the wife hears a noise and asks the husband to be quiet and listen. He realises somebody is trying to get in.

beats.en: The husband whispers a plan to his wife. They will pretend to talk to each other, while the thief listens. Inside, the thief thinks: they are awake, and I will have to wait until they fall asleep.
beats.speakEn: The husband whispers a plan to his wife. They will pretend to talk to each other, while the thief listens. Inside, the thief thinks: they are awake, and I will have to wait until they fall asleep.
